tagline: Supplemental insurance and voluntary benefits provider with significant operations in Japan
hero_kpi_rationale: Key measure of segment performance and vital indicator for understanding the underlying profitability drivers and business trends at Aflac, particularly for Aflac Japan which generates the majority of earnings.

ai_positioning.summary: Aflac uses AI internally to improve customer experience and develop new products, but is also aware of the associated cybersecurity risks.
evidence: The Company will continue to incur expenses related to, among other things, investments in digital capabilities and product innovation including the development and use of artificial intelligence (AI).
The Company s development of new technology, including the use of AI by the Company and third-party vendors, could lead to an increased risk of a business interruption or a cybersecurity breach.

The rapid evolution and increased adoption of artificial intelligence technologies may also heighten the Company's cybersecurity risks by making cyber-attacks more difficult to detect, contain, and mitigate.

kpis.name: Pretax Adjusted Earnings
kpis.explanation: Pretax adjusted earnings measure used to evaluate segment performance and underlying profitability drivers
kpis.description: Company adjusted pre-tax earnings for Aflac Japan, a key indicator of financial performance of insurance segments.

kpis.name: Net Earned Premiums
kpis.explanation: Net earned premiums from insurance operations, key revenue metric for insurance segment performance
kpis.description: Net premiums earned by the company for Aflac Japan, a key insurance revenue indicator.

kpis.name: Adjusted Net Investment Income
kpis.explanation: Adjusted Net Investment income generated over the period.
kpis.description: Adjusted net investment income of the company for Aflac Japan, after deduction of amortized hedging costs.

kpis.name: Fair Value Fixed Maturity Securities
kpis.explanation: Total market value of Aflac's bond portfolio, reflecting exposure to rates and credit.
kpis.description: Aflac's fixed-income securities portfolio shows a fair value of $79.6B as of 12/31/2025, for an amortized cost of $81.4B, equating to net latent losses of ~$1.8B. The main concentration is in government bonds (41.5%) and corporates (30%).

kpis.name: Gross Unrealized Losses Fixed Maturities
kpis.explanation: Total amount of latent losses on the bond portfolio, key indicator of interest rate and credit risk.
kpis.description: Gross latent losses on fixed-income securities total $6.655B as of 12/31/2025, mainly concentrated in government bonds ($4.442B) and other corporates ($1.131B), reflecting the high-rate environment.

kpis.name: Privately Issued Securities Fair Value
kpis.explanation: Market value of privately placed securities, mainly held by Aflac Japan to optimize yield and asset-liability matching.
kpis.description: Privately placed securities reach $16.2B in fair value as of 12/31/2025 compared to $15.7B in 2024 (+3.0%), mainly driven by Aflac Japan which uses them to secure yields above Japanese public bonds.

kpis.name: Aflac Japan U.S. Dollar Program Amortized Cost
kpis.explanation: Total outstanding US dollar investments held by Aflac Japan and hedged against yen/dollar currency risk.
kpis.description: Aflac Japan's USD investment program reaches $23.5B in amortized cost as of 12/31/2025 vs $21.3B in 2024 (+10.3%), reflecting an active diversification strategy toward higher-yielding assets hedged in yen.

kpis.name: Reverse Dual-Currency Securities % of Total
kpis.explanation: Share of securities with yen principal and USD interest in the total portfolio, a tool to manage FX and yield risk.
kpis.description: Reverse dual-currency securities represent 5.0% of total portfolio as of 12/31/2025 (vs 5.3% in 2024), for an outstanding amount of $4.091B compared to $4.313B, reflecting a slight reduction of this hybrid yen/USD exposure.

kpis.name: Adjusted EPS
kpis.explanation: Adjusted earnings per share: Aflac's true profit per share, excluding exceptional items to better assess actual performance.

kpis.name: Premium Income Japan
kpis.explanation: Measures insurance premium revenues generated in Japan, showing Aflac's business health in its primary market.

kpis.name: Premium Income US
kpis.explanation: Measures insurance premiums collected in the US, showing Aflac's business health in its primary market.

kpis.name: Capital Returned
kpis.explanation: Measures money Aflac returns to shareholders through dividends and share buybacks.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Dividend Per Share — total dividends paid divided by shares outstanding.
kpis.description: Dividend per share paid annually, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last 7 fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend cut risk, monitor payout sustainability

kpis.name: Capital Returned (Dividends)
kpis.explanation: Capital Return — total cash returned to shareholders (dividends + buybacks).
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last 4 reported fiscal years.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Payout Ratio — dividends paid divided by net income.
kpis.description: Payout ratio = Dividends paid / Net income, calculated over the last 4 fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Shareholder returns growing, dividend policy supportive

company_description: Aflac Incorporated, through its subsidiaries, provides supplemental health and life insurance products. It operates in two segments, Aflac Japan and Aflac U.S. The Aflac Japan segment offers cancer, medical, nursing care, whole life, and GIFT insurance products, as well as WAYS and child endowment, and Tsumitasu insurance products in Japan. Its Aflac U.S. segment provides accident, disability, cancer, critical illness, hospital indemnity, dental, vision, and life insurance products in the United States. The company also provides hearing, final expense, pet, Medicare supplement, supplemental dental and vision, short-term disability, and absence management insurance products, as well as cafeteria plans. It sells its products to individuals, families, and business owners through individual, independent corporate, and affiliated corporate agencies; banks; independent associates/career agents; and brokers. Aflac Incorporated was founded in 1955 and is headquartered in Columbus, Georgia.
